<b>{{PAGENAME}}s</b> are miscellaneous crafting materials, mined from outcroppings found in the dungeon, on levels 8, 11, 13 and 15. One node of Diamond can also be found in the [[Souls room|Souls Room]]. These crystal protrusions require a pick axe to be mined, as well as the appropriate [[Building (Tech Tree)|technology]] to be unlocked. Each of these crystals will yield 4x diamonds (or 5x with the Jeweler [[perk]]). 

In [[Versions|v1.3]], a bug was temporarily introduced where the [[merchant]] was unable to sell or buy this item. In [[Versions|v1.4]], this is once again possible.<ref>[https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/599140/view/3106914346358961385 Release notes for v1.4]</ref>
